thread:
release-bot: Deploy window open for service/llm-router v3.2.4. Feature flag plan: `llmroute.v3.gentle` 0% -> 3% -> 15% over 30m. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Paging @sara @leo for monitoring.

sara: noted. I'll keep dashboards on p50/p95 and token cost. link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/releases/llm-router/v3.2.4/runbook

miguel: request: set an emergency pin threshold at 2% error-rate increase OR +250ms p95 latency. Prefer auto-pin but will be ready to manual pin.

anya: suggestion: disable the large-quant model shard on first step and keep small-quant enabled. This reduces memory pressure.

release-bot: Updated plan: 1) toggle `llmroute.v3.gentle` -> 3% 2) wait 10m, check metrics 3) advance to 15% if stable. Auto-pin if 5xx delta >1.0pp for 5m OR p95 +250ms. Auto-pin target: v3.1.8.

ops-bot: Preflight: infra ok, db replica lag 0.3s, GPU headroom 32%.

leo: I'll run the initial toggle in ~2m. command: 
```
/redwood flag set --name llmroute.v3.gentle --pct 3 --author leo --note "gentle ramp step1"
```

tim: starting a lightweight eval against recent prompts. will report semantic regressions.

sara: metrics after 4m at 3%: p95 baseline 200ms -> 230ms, 5xx steady 0.4% -> 0.6%. acceptable.

miguel: saw two error traces that look like cache serialization failures (trace ids: t-202, t-211). tagging infra-cache.

ops-bot: alert channel armed: `alerts/llmroute/errors` will page @miguel and call `release-bot pin` if sustained >1.5% for 3m.

anya: keep ramp slow. hold 3% for another 12m. also recommend we enable verbose sampling on canary for a while.

release-bot: proceeding to step 2 in 10m unless someone aborts. Posting short note to #release-notes: "llm-router v3.2.4 gentle ramp started"

leo: advancing to 15% now. running: 
```
/redwood flag set --name llmroute.v3.gentle --pct 15 --author leo --note "step2 to 15%"
```

sara: p95 rose to 280ms at 15% and token throughput steady. error rate jumped to 1.9% at 03:22.

miguel: I'm seeing 1.9% errors for 2.5m, initiated manual pin to v3.1.8 to stop the bleed. Command run by miguel:
```
/release pin --service llm-router --version v3.1.8 --who miguel --reason "error spike during ramp"
```

release-bot: Manual pin recorded at 8467890175 by miguel. Rolling cohorts back to v3.1.8; draining v3.2.4 nodes. Posting rollback summary to #release-notes: "v3.2.4 halted at step2 after elevated errors; pinned to v3.1.8. Investigation ongoing."

anya: opening incident: include cache traces and sample inputs. assigning to infra-cache team and model-eval.

ops-bot: recommendation: block reattempt until cache fix deployed and a 24h soak on staging. Also propose a rework: try 1% -> 5% -> 15% next time with quant shard disabled until 5%.

sara: agreed. updating the release ticket and backlog. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
